verdict.rationale: Linear's own initiatives and strategic roadmaps are a portfolio-level construct: initiatives have lead teams, proposed/canceled statuses, and priority, and are described as showing how work contributes to the broader direction. The evidence never documents that initiatives aggregate progress from their projects into a single rolled-up view; the custom-dashboards item is a third-party integration and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented roll-up of progress across multiple projects, an explicit single portfolio/roadmap view showing that aggregated progress, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: You can now assign a team to lead an initiative, making it clear who is responsible for driving the work and how it contributes to the broader direction.
Priority communicates which initiatives are most important
Align your team with product initiatives, strategic roadmaps, and clear, up-to-date PRDs.
